water_regulator.test: Derek holds the fixture and rocks the YZMSZ regulator back and forth, then turns it to show the other end.

water_regulator.interpretation: The closing remark says “flow meter” while the white regulator with the blue clip is in view. Both the earlier demonstration and the written instruction identify the YZMSZ water regulator for the saddle change.
